130:t_000:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We have arrived at the target location.」

130:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「To think this is the $$第３新東京市$$...」

130:t_000:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Not only the surface urban area, but the $$ジオフロント$$, including the $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ HQ, has vanished completely.」

130:t_000:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Watch your wording. ...They have not vanished... They were merely transferred to another world.」

130:t_000:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「No... You are not at fault, XO. Anyone would feel that way after being shown that phenomenon, which one could even call $$サードインパクト$$, and this ruined site...」

130:t_000:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「But at the very least, let us be the ones who believe they are safe.」

130:t_000:8.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain, the observation team reports that no contamination of the atmosphere or other environmental factors was detected.」

130:t_000:9.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Also, a request for permission to land has come in.」

130:t_000:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「I'll leave the decision to Captain $$アムロ$$. The pilots must have things on their minds too.」

130:t_000:11.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「...Captain! Emergency communication from Director $$大塚$$!」

130:t_000:12.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ force that was expected to invade $$新日本$$ is heading this way!」

130:t_000:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Cancel the landing permission! Prepare to sortie immediately!」

130:t_000:14.en:
$$レイアム$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ incoming!」

130:t_001:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「What a number of them! Are they launching an all-out attack!?」

130:t_001:1.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「All units are ready to sortie!」

130:t_001:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Launch them at once! The enemy is going all in!」

130:t_002:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The commander is $$ダバラーン・タウ$$...!」

130:t_002:2.en:
$n
「Bad luck for you too! If you wanted to attack Japan, you should have done it while we were away!」

130:t_002:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I understood it in our last battle... that you are the rivals worthy of setting my blood as a $$ハイアデス$$ ablaze...!」

130:t_002:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That is precisely why I'll crush you before I take down this Japan!」

130:t_002:7.en:
$n
「You went out of your way to come here just to fight us...!?」

130:t_002:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Exactly! This land, still bearing the scars of the $$時空震動$$, will be the stage for the battle between you and me!」

130:t_002:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What does that man think battle is...!?」

130:t_002:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「A place to set my blood ablaze...! Battle itself is my very life!」

130:t_002:13.en:
$n
「After the $$時獄戦役$$ ended, everyone was happy that peace had finally come... and you trample all over that with your own selfish logic...!」

130:t_002:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A guy like that shouldn't be allowed to exist on this Earth!」

130:t_002:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Deny me all you like! If you think I'm the enemy, then prove it by eliminating me!」

130:t_002:16.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「With all the strength you have!」

130:t_002:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, be careful...! This isn't like the probing attacks before!」

130:t_002:18.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think my $$バン・アルデバル$$ is the same as that $$アドラティオ$$ from before.」

130:t_002:19.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「This is the arms and legs of the $$ハイアデス$$! The ultimate weapon, man and ship truly as one!」

130:t_002:20.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Man and ship as one...?」

130:t_002:21.en:
$$カツ$$
「That guy...! Is he trying to say he's become one with that battleship!?」

130:t_002:22.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now, $$ハイアデス$$! Let us begin the greatest battle!」

130:t_002:23.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We shall dedicate our battle to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

130:t_002:24.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, intercept! Don't let that battle maniac have his way with Japan!」

130:t_002:25.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't lose...! Not to people like this...!」

130:t_002:26.en:
$n
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$! We'll stop you!」

130:t_003:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「As expected of you, $c! You're weathering my fierce assault well!」

130:t_003:1.en:
$$カツ$$
「Fierce assault, my foot! It's just brute force, relying on numbers!」

130:t_003:2.en:
$$エマ$$
「I hate to admit it, but if we keep fighting like this, our losses will skyrocket too...!」

130:t_003:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If only $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ were here with us...」

130:t_003:4.en:
$n
「...$$バナージ$$, give us the usual line.」

130:t_003:6.en:
$n
「Then today, I'll be the one to say it...!」

130:t_003:9.en:
$n
「If we back down here, he'll wreck Japan...! And if that happens, our school will be in danger too!」

130:t_003:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...All right, $n. I've made up my mind too.」

130:t_003:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I like that resolve! You're every bit the rival I judged you to be!」

130:t_003:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But... no, precisely because of that, I won't hold back! I'll crush you with all my strength!」

130:t_003:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$... You're certainly strong, both as a commander and as a warrior.」

130:t_003:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But all you seem to know is how to trample others with force.」

130:t_003:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Remember this! Even if you try to crush someone with force like you do, there are plenty of people who never stop resisting!」

130:t_004:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! $$紅月カレン$$ of the $$黒の騎士団$$ is here!」

130:t_004:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「The $$黒の騎士団$$!? They should have their hands full defending $$新日本$$!」

130:t_004:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The best defense is a good offense... At least our commander thinks so.」

130:t_004:5.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Above all, if Japan falls here, $$新日本$$ will be caught in a pincer.」

130:t_004:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ゼクス$$ and $$ノイン$$ are here too.」

130:t_004:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$サイデリアル$$! If you think you can do as you please just because you have the numbers, you're sorely mistaken!」

130:t_004:8.en:
$n
「Don't think it's just four reinforcements. Each one of us is worth a thousand!」

130:t_004:13.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Exactly! When those hailed as worth a thousand have arrived, I cannot hold back the surge of my blood!」

130:t_004:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I thank you, $c! And I thank you, Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

130:t_004:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「For granting this $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ such a place to fight!」
